showcaseApi._v1: Version 9 = the QED64 embedding contract v1 adoption (deps/qed64/docs/EMBEDDING.md). The gallery decides its mode from gallery/pin.json: V1 = (apiRevision != null; read by scripts/build-gallery.mjs from release/<pin>/dist/qed64-build.json, with `shell`), except when the server serves another pin's release than pin.json describes (X-Showcase-Pin of the pin.json response; a staged pin): then that release's own revision: serve.mjs's X-Showcase-Api header (<apiRevision>|none, read at server start from the served release's dist/qed64-build.json, schema qed64.build/v1) on the same pin.json response, and only without that header its /qed64-build.json (404 = legacy) (status().modeSource 'served', else 'pin.json'; the deployed Worker sends neither header). A v1 page must report capabilities documents, events, embedMode and restart (else the hard boot card; status().api.missing). In V1 mode the frame is '/?embed=1&snapshots=snapshots/<overlay>' (+ '&memory=<GiB>' for ?mem=) with the example as '#code=' + encodeURIComponent(text); the API comes from the 'qed64:frame-api' CustomEvent (detail.frame === the iframe's contentWindow) or, as a fallback, a polled frozen pageWin().qed64.api; the gallery never touches qed64.relay / qed64.ui / qed64.status() / qed64.editor / localStorage['qed64.buffer'] / the page's #boot DOM / any __qed64* name (the ONE internal dependency left is the narrow-screen stacking style, applyStack/applyPageStyle, which never throws or fails a boot; layout= is v1.1). Waits poll api.status() every 100 ms (ready = phase 'ready' | 'headerRefused' with relay 'serving', api.getDocument().text === the wanted text, version >= setDocument's; boot failure = status().boot.failed; status().boot.overlay replaces the #boot check); switch = api.setDocument(text, {cursor, focus:false, undoable:false}) (focus moves only in shown() after ready, as legacy); restarts = api.restart() (how 'api.restart'); refused header without 'mathlib' = api.restart({snapshots:['init','mathlib']}) + settled afterSession. The UX suite (tests/ux/lib/qed64.mjs GALLERY_PIN / API) applies the same rule and branches on it (and on PIN.liveness.builtIn).

showcaseApi.currentText(): the editor model's text or null
showcaseApi.liveness(mode): the L7 liveness probe: with mode ('auto' | 'observe' | 'off') switches it (observe = detect and record, never restart: hang hunts; also ?liveness=observe); returns status().liveness. Probes are textDocument/hover at 0:0 with string ids showcase-live-<n> and full params, each sent with a main-loop probe ($/showcase/liveness, string id showcase-main-<n>, params {}: an unknown method the FileWorker's main loop answers MethodNotFound at once, without a pool thread; liveness.mainLoop); a hover reply later than probeTimeoutMs is late by its elapsed time (never 'answered'); replies are swallowed in the relay.toClient tap; 2 unanswered (probeTimeoutMs each) after probeAfterMs of silence = wedged; auto restarts once per restartGapMs (relay.restart, notice 'Lean stopped responding and was restarted'), then the stall card is the fallback (UX suite C21, C22). On a QED64 page with its own liveness (status().liveness present: QED64 9fdf9b8+, HARDENING #52) the probe DEFERS to it: it starts only after probeDeferMs (30 s; ?probeDefer=<s>) without progress, never acts while QED64 reports a stall in its grace window (action 'deferred'), and QED64's own rescues, stalls and 'wedged' reboots are reported in liveness.qed64 and the qed64-* events (notice 'Lean stopped responding; QED64 is restarting it')
invariants: legacy pins: status().bridge.installs[*].qed64Present === false and status().bridge.late === 0 (installed before the page's module script; a late install lets the page's own listener run too); v1 pins: status().bridge.installed === false, stoodDown === true, installs [] and late 0, bridgeStats() === null (W1-W8, C20 assert it)
status().stall.shown === 0 on a healthy run (no false stall alarm; W1-W8 and C20 assert it), thresholdMs 45000 by default (?stall=<s> overrides, >= 5)

status().liveness.wedged === 0 and restarts === 0 on a healthy run (no false liveness alarm; W1-W8, C20 and C22 assert it), probeAfterMs 10000 / probeTimeoutMs 5000 / restartGapMs 120000 by default (?probe, ?probeTimeout, ?restartGap override); v1 pins: status().liveness.probe === 'stood-down' and sent === 0 always (W1-W8, C20, C21, C22, C23 assert it)

v1 pins: status().seed.action === 'embed' and localStorage['qed64.buffer'] on the QED64 origin is never read or written by the gallery or the embedded page (C1 seeds a sentinel and requires it unchanged); status().qed64.offer === null for every gallery example (C3)
showcaseApi.storage: qed64-showcase:saved (first displaced user buffer, never overwritten), qed64-showcase:saved-history (later ones, newest first, max 5), qed64-showcase:edited-example (the latest gallery-edited example, one slot; never counted as a user buffer); v1: qed64-showcase:document (the text of the last `document` event, the gallery's own persistence in embed mode: written at most once per second, last write wins on pagehide, restored by api.setDocument on an adopted frame reload; UX suite C25). In v1 the gallery never displaces qed64.buffer; the saved/history/edited-example keys are written when a v1 boot displaces a user text (or an edited example) held in qed64-showcase:document, exactly as a legacy boot does for qed64.buffer; 'Open my saved buffer' opens them and buffers saved by earlier legacy visits

consoleAllowlist._why: docs: gallery/README.md 'Console messages'. Anything not listed fails the UX suite (pageerror, console.error, console.warning, crash).

consoleError.note: monaco-vscode-api NotificationService.notify: an LSP RequestCancelled (-32800) reply with an empty message (codeAction cancelled by an edit or the header); pairWith: each one must be explained by its own LSP -32800 error reply seen by the LSP tap (tests/ux/lib/lsp-tap.mjs) in the 3 s before it (or 0.5 s after); fail-closed without tap reports

consoleError.text: ^QED64: the document changed before this request reached the checker$
consoleError.note: v1 pins (QED64 edit coalescing, deps/qed64/docs/EMBEDDING.md §7.8; frontend/src/embed/edit-coalescer.ts SUPERSEDED): a semanticTokens or completion request queued behind a full-text change that a newer change replaced is answered ContentModified (-32801, message 'QED64: the document changed before this request reached the checker', error.data.qed64.kind 'superseded'), which lean4monaco logs at the same NotificationService site (typing with the suggest widget open prints one such line per superseding change; vscode-languageclient itself treats it as 'ask again' and logs nothing). The same discipline as the -32800 entry: the same NotificationService site (line0 627, hash-pinned per pin in pins/<id>/pin.json consoleSites), the text anchored to the v1 message exactly (lean4monaco prints the reply's message, as the empty one of -32800 shows), and pairWith requires its own LSP -32801 error reply seen by the LSP tap within -3 s/+0.5 s; fail-closed without tap reports; no count limit. Legacy pins: their bundles carry no such message (the legacy front door's fail-fast ContentModified reply has a different text, lsp-front-door.js:288), so this entry matches nothing there and pins A-E assert exactly what they asserted before

consoleError.text: ^QED64: the client cancelled this request before it reached the checker$
consoleError.note: pin G and later v1 pins (QED64 5c327c2: e4cffcc's back-pressure, deps/qed64/docs/EMBEDDING.md §7.8; frontend/src/embed/edit-coalescer.ts CANCELLED): a request still QUEUED in the edit coalescer (behind a held change, or waiting for one of the 6 request slots) whose $/cancelRequest arrives is answered locally with RequestCancelled (-32800, message 'QED64: the client cancelled this request before it reached the checker', error.data.qed64.kind 'cancelled'); resident-session.ts sends it through lean.onLsp, the relay's toClient, so the LSP tap (tests/ux/lib/lsp-tap.mjs) records it as an errorReply like the others (qed64Kind 'cancelled'). The site (line0 627, hash-pinned in pins/<id>/pin.json consoleSites) is monaco-vscode-api's StandaloneNotificationService.notify, which console.errors the message of EVERY Error-severity notification; an LSP error reply reaches it only through the callers that hand the error to the notification service, not for every reply (vscode-languageclient's handleFailedRequest returns the default for a RequestCancelled whose token was cancelled and turns the rest into a CancellationError, which logs nothing). That a -32800 reply does reach it on some path is shown by the empty-message entry above (Lean's own RequestCancelled for the same kind of cancelled request); QED64's local reply now answers such a request when it is still queued, so that path prints this text instead of ''. Not observed in a browser run yet: a pre-allowance with the same discipline as the -32800/-32801 entries: the text anchored to the message exactly, the same site, and pairWith its own LSP -32800 reply seen by the tap within -3 s/+0.5 s; fail-closed without tap reports; no count limit. Pins A-F carry no such message, so the entry matches nothing there.

v1 pins (QED64 5c327c2+, docs/EMBEDDING.md §4): a ?snapshots= overlay index that is missing (HTTP <status>, src/runtime/snapshots.ts) or unreachable (fetch rejects: 'Failed to fetch') is a NAMED boot failure thrown out of main() (frontend/src/qed64-boot.ts fetchSnapshotIndexFor: '?snapshots=<dir>: <msg>'); the page reports it as api.status().boot {failed, message} and its top-level catch (frontend/src/main.ts:625-629) console.error(err)s the Error, which Chromium records as 'Error: <message>' followed by its stack. It replaces, on v1, the legacy relay death lines (entries [0]/[1]): Lean never starts, so no relay dies. Anchored to the first line (the directory named twice must be the same WHOLE value, 'snapshots/' prefix included or absent in both: QED64 fetches /<dir>/index.json for ?snapshots=<dir>, frontend/src/qed64-boot.ts:118, with <dir> validated by frontend/src/embed/params.ts DIR_RULES ^(?:snapshots/)?<segment>$; up to the stack's first frame), the active pin's main bundle only, the bootFailure scenario only; no line0 (pin-switch.mjs requires every line0 to be a hash-pinned notify site, and this is main()'s catch, not one). Observed in run g-full1b: C8 stock ('?snapshots=snapshots/nope: /snapshots/nope/index.json: HTTP 404', main bundle line 1369) and C12 overlay-offline-stock ('?snapshots=snapshots/widgets8: Failed to fetch', line 1369). Any other uncaught main() error ('Error: runtime manifest: …', a refused parameter, another index fault text) still fails. Legacy pins A-E never print it (a missing overlay is a silent 'no snapshots' there, failing later through the relay), so it matches nothing on them.

rpcKeepAliveStarved.note: pin G (QED64 5c327c2: e4cffcc's request cap, frontend/src/embed/edit-coalescer.ts maxInFlightRequests, DEFAULT_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_REQUESTS 6; docs/EMBEDDING.md §7.8 'every frame behind it waits in order'; pinned by tests/unit/edit-coalescer.test.ts:613-623): during a silent elaboration over 30 s the InfoView's position-bound requests fill the 6 slots, so its $/lean/rpc/keepAlive notifications wait behind them in the coalescer; Lean 4.34 expires an RPC session after keepAliveTimeMs 30000 (FileWorker/Utils.lean:188, erased at FileWorker.lean:943-947), and when the slots free, Lean itself answers each queued $/lean/rpc/call -32900 'Outdated RPC session' (Rpc/RequestHandling.lean:84), which lean4monaco logs at its NotificationService site (line0 627) and the InfoView reconnects. No session was replaced. QED64 defect (keep-alives should never wait for a request slot; draft report, not posted). Pairing: each line needs its OWN -32900 reply seen by the LSP tap with qed64Kind null and that exact message (Lean's own reply; a relay-made '-32900 QED64: …' restart reply can never explain it) within -3 s/+0.5 s; fail-closed without tap reports. Only in C22 (tests/ux/specs/25-stall.spec.mjs), only on the pins listed there as having the cap without the keep-alive fix, and C22 also requires every such reply to fall in a phase silent for at least 30 s and the InfoView to reconnect after it. Observed in run g-full1b: C22 (s10) 9 lines, 5 at t 55063-55067 (end of the 38 s #eval) and 4 at t 166794 (end of the 55 s saturated sleep), each 0-2 ms after Lean's own -32900 reply.

exclusiveScenarios.why: classifyConsole takes the FIRST matching rule, and relayRestartOrReboot[0] allows the same '^Outdated RPC session$' line unpaired: declared together, it would match the keep-alive lines first and switch off rpcKeepAliveStarved's pairing with Lean's own -32900 replies (qed64Kind null). A verdict that declares both fails (conflicts), whatever was logged.

_scenarioNotes.relayRestartOrReboot: tests in which a session is disposed or replaced on purpose (C10 reload storm, C11 network cut, C16 exact imports, C21 Restart Lean / Reset on a frozen checker, C23 the forced wedged reboot, C25 the frame reload the gallery adopts; C20 and W1-W8 only when a stall or a QED64 'wedged' reboot occurred): the InfoView's old RPC session is refused once per request ('Outdated RPC session'), and the page's heap meter's pending telemetry request rejects 'Session disposed.' (QED64 N2). Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.bootFailure: tests that deliberately make the boot fail (C8 missing overlay, C9 unpaired overlay, C11 network cut, C12 unreachable overlay): the relay's own death path logs and throws 'QED64: the Lean checker died (bootFailed)' once per counted death (3 before the breaker), and a missing overlay file is a 404 resource error. On v1 pins (QED64 5c327c2+, EMBEDDING.md §4) a missing or unreachable ?snapshots= overlay index is instead a named failure before Lean starts: no relay death, one 'Error: ?snapshots=<dir>: …' console.error from main()'s catch (entry [4]). Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.networkCut: tests that cut the network on purpose (C11 CHAOS, C12 aborted routes): Chromium logs the aborted / truncated resource, and QED64's snapshot prefetcher warns that it falls back to streaming. Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.exactImportsFallback: C16 only: after 'Load exact imports' QED64 compiles the header's import lines against the essential pack; when that fails it warns '[qed64] exact import failed: …; serving the header from the preloaded library' and keeps serving the covered header (resident-session.ts:209-224, the designed degradation C16 checks).
_scenarioNotes.qed64WedgedReboot: C23 (its forced-death fixture), and C20 and W1-W8 only when QED64 9fdf9b8+ itself declared a session wedged and rebooted it (an L7 occurrence handled upstream, status().liveness.qed64.wedgedReboots > 0): its relay answers every request in flight with 'QED64: the Lean checker died (wedged)' (lsp-relay.ts onDied -> failInFlight), which lean4monaco logs at the same site as stallRestart. Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.livenessObserved: tests (or hang hunts, UX_LIVENESS=observe) in which the gallery's liveness probe, in OBSERVE mode, declares a frozen checker wedged: gallery.js logs one console.warn per wedge and restarts nothing (C21 (b); C20 and W1-W8 only when an observe-mode wedge was recorded). Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.rpcKeepAliveStarved: C22 only, and only on a pin whose edit coalescer caps the requests in flight without letting $/lean/rpc/keepAlive pass (QED64 5c327c2; the list in tests/ux/specs/25-stall.spec.mjs KEEPALIVE_STARVED_PINS): a silent elaboration over Lean's 30 s RPC keep-alive window starves the InfoView's keep-alives behind the 6 occupied request slots, Lean expires the RPC session and answers the queued rpc calls -32900 'Outdated RPC session' (its own reply, qed64Kind null). Paired one-to-one with those replies; C22 also requires each reply to fall in a phase silent for at least 30 s and an RPC reconnect after it, and still proves no restart through its session, restart, death and reboot counters. Never allowed in any other test, and never on a pin that fixes the keep-alive queueing.
_scenarioNotes.stallRestart: tests that answer a stalled checker (QED64 L7) with the gallery's Restart Lean / Reset (C21; C20 and W1-W8 only when a real stall was recovered): QED64's relay.restart() answers every request still in flight with the hard-coded error 'QED64: restarting with exact imports' (lsp-relay.ts:127 failInFlight; -32603, rpc calls -32900), which lean4monaco logs at its NotificationService site and leaves as an unhandled rejection. A stalled checker always has requests in flight (nothing was answered), so a restart of one produces these; a restart from ready (C16) has none. Never allowed in any other test.
